description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, outlining asynchronous methods related to basket operations in the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: An interface for basket-related operations, including transferring, adding items, setting quantities, and deleting baskets.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous user ID to a registered username asynchronously.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket with specified catalog item ID, price, and quantity asynchronously.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for items in a basket, returning the updated basket result asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID asynchronously.
